description: Dreamwalker Legguards Level 60 Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Legguards if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 8 Cured Rugged Hides and 1 Nexus Crystal. Requirements: - Desecrated Legguards - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 20 - Cured Rugged Hide x 8 - Nexus Crystal
